before:
# if a local callback script is declared, run it, passing to it the ramdisk directory (first call)
  if [ -n "$FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT" -a -f "$FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT" ]; then
	bash $FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT "$FOX_RAMDISK" "--first-call"
  fi
after:
# A declared callback is required: never fall back to unverified root addons.
  if [ -n "$FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT" ]; then
    [ -f "$FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT" ] || { echo 'Missing required OrangeFox callback' >&2; exit 1; }
    bash "$FOX_LOCAL_CALLBACK_SCRIPT" "$FOX_RAMDISK" "--first-call" || exit $?
  fi
